{{Top|leg}}
The '''S'kytri Council Tower''' was the [[champagne]]-[[Color/Legends|colored]] tower in which the [[Supreme Council of the Highland Clans]] convened. It was separated from the rest of the [[City of the Winged People]] by a wide chasm. Since the [[S'kytri]] were a flying [[Species/Legends|species]], they had no trouble accessing the tower. However, an open-air causeway had been installed so that the "walkers" wishing to address the Supreme Council could traverse the chasm.<ref name="swcw">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>
